lineage.description: Building polygons were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Serbia using the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 1.8 million mapped buildings with an average data age of 2 years, sourced from volunteer contributions and AI-assisted mapping estimates covering approximately 34% of total building inventory.
